text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mmm! The air at shrines always feels so crisp and refreshing, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
They say sickness is all in your head, right?
So I thought I'd just blow this slump away!♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's get this done
in a snap!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, that felt super refreshing!
Totally mind-blowing~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right now, I feel like I could fever the night away at the disco♪ Just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's head back to the academy at Mach speed!
We've gotta start training right away!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm going to hit it out of the park today~!

It seemed she truly felt back in top shape, as her
driving that day was sharper than ever.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that concludes our shrine visit!
Let's head right back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Tacchan's keys are gone~?!
I know I put them in my pocket...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww! Where did you go,
my little key~?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Haa, after going all the way to pray at the shrine, my luck is terrible. That is so cho-veri-ba...
Perhaps due to a stroke of bad luck, Maruzensky just couldn't get into top gear.
